prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean Pleasanton, CA (East Bay)? And are you looking for spray tans (airbrush / booth) or UV tanning beds? Preferences (price, closeness to a specific neighborhood, single visit vs. membership) will help me recommend a specific salon.

Until you tell me, here’s how to find the “best” one and what to look for:

How to find top salons
- Search Google Maps and Yelp for “tanning salon Pleasanton CA” and sort by rating + recent reviews.
- Check Facebook and Nextdoor for local recommendations and before/after photos.
- Read recent reviews (last 6–12 months) and look for photos—consistent good results matter more than a single 5‑star.

What to look for (spray tan vs UV)
- Spray tan: certified technicians, airbrush or professional booth, quality solutions (e.g., Versa, Norvell, Mystic), patch-test policy, portfolio of before/after photos, positive feedback about color and longevity.
- UV tanning: well‑maintained, up‑to‑date beds, clear staff training, consultation about skin type and session length, clean facility and goggles provided. (Remember UV increases skin cancer risk—follow safe limits.)

Questions to ask a salon
- Which brand of spray solution or tanning beds do you use?
- How long will the tan last and what aftercare do you recommend?
- Do you do a test patch for first-time clients?
- Are technicians certified (for spray) and how old is the equipment (for UV)?
- What are rates, package deals, cancellation policies?

Safety & quality tips
- For spray tans: avoid heavy perfumes/lotions before the appointment; follow pre/post instructions to maximize evenness and longevity.
- For UV tanning: limit frequency, use proper eye protection, and get a skin check from your physician if you tan regularly.
- Always check for good ventilation and cleanliness.

If you want, tell me:
- spray or UV,
- your location in Pleasanton,
- and any priorities (budget, private airbrush, fast service).
I’ll then give a shortlist of likely top options and sample questions to call each salon (I can’t browse the live web for you, but I can help evaluate any names you give).
